decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement SJR/D02, dated 26th February 2015; Flood Risk Assessment FRA02, dated 26th February 2015; -received 06/03/2015.  SJR/BC-01 rev F, dated 28/03/2015; SJR/04-1 rev F, dated 28/03/2015; -received 20/04/2015.  SJR/04-2 rev F, dated 25/02/2015; - received 01/04/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 116 St John's Road.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied until measures have been put in place to reinstate the footway in place of the remainder of the redundant crossover.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to the house. Erection of a front porch, car port and bin/bike storage unit and formation of a vehicular access.
